newsitem.title: USA: Institutional Investor shuts down forex newsletter.
newsitem.headline: Institutional Investor shuts down forex newsletter.

text.p: Institutional Investor Inc has decided to discontinue publication of Foreign Exchange Letter, said Tom Lamont, editor of the company's newsletter division.
"We are not in this for the practice. It was losing money," said Lamont regarding Institutional Investor's decision.
Foreign Exchange Letter, which was started four years ago, is one of 22 newsletters covering the financial services industry currently published by the company.
Lamont said the closing of the publication "had absolutely nothing" to do with the potential sale of Institutional Investor by its current owner, Walt Disney Co.
In January, Disney said it was considering selling most of the newspaper and publishing assets it acquired in connection with its merger with Capital Cities/ABC Inc last year.
Disney has hired Credit Suisse First Boston as an advisor.

Lamont added the closing of Foreign Exchange Letter was not connected with any change in the condition of the foreign exchange industry. "It's just an industry populated by people who don't read newsletters a lot," he said.

The last issue of Foreign Exchange Letter will be published on May 5. Current subcribers will be given a choice of receiving two other newsletters of their choice, or being reimbursed in cash for the balance of their subscriptions, Lamont said.

The company will urge customers to subscribe to Derivatives Week, another Institutional Investor newsletter. Lamont said that publication will increase its coverage of the foreign exchange markets in light of the closure of Foreign Exchange Letter.
